review:
BGaming's original 2016 Zeus slot. Same maths as the Deluxe version, just the older look – which some people actually prefer.

Scatters pay anywhere, with three, four or five multiplying the win by 7x, 77x and 777x. Two bonus symbols on reels 1 and 5 give 10 free spins with those reels locked wild and only the middle spinning, so most bonus spins hit. Medium-high volatility, 8,888x max, 96.29% RTP.
pros: Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 112 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
